info.name: DonghuaStream - Platform Streaming API
info.description:
Postman Collection untuk Project Akhir: Platform Streaming Website Donghua.

Fitur yang diuji:
- Auth (Register & Login)
- Film / Donghua (CRUD)
- Episode (Navigasi antar Episode)
- Watching List & History
- Rating & Comment (Community)

Arsitektur: MongoDB + Express.js REST API
Base URL: {{base_url}}
